name: Deep Research
title: Multi-step web research with disk notes and cited Markdown reports
description: Breaks a research question into sub-questions, searches the web, reads pages onto disk, checks every quote against its source, and writes a cited Markdown (.md) report in the workspace.

functions.name: research_start
functions.description: Start a research project in the workspace folder. Creates research/<slug>/ (or uses a custom output .md path) and returns the project id and context budget.

question.description: The main question or topic to research

mode.description: quick (fast overview), standard (default balanced research), or deep (shows plan first and checks contradictions)

output.description: Optional .md file path in the workspace where the final report should be saved

context_tokens.description: Optional context size in tokens (such as 4096, 8192, or 16384)

functions.name: research_plan
functions.description: Save 2 to 7 sub-questions for the research project. In deep mode, show the returned plan to the user before searching.

id.description: The research project id from research_start

sub_questions.description: List of 2 to 7 specific sub-questions to answer

confirmed.description: In deep mode, set true after the user approves the plan

functions.name: research_search
functions.description: Search the web for one sub-question, deduplicate URLs, and register sources as S1, S2, and so on.

functions.name: research_read
functions.description: Fetch a source (such as S1 or a URL), save the full page to disk under sources/Sn.md, and return the top relevant facts with exact quotes.

source.description: Source id from research_search (such as S1) or a direct URL

sub_question.description: Sub-question number (1-based) to rank passages against

functions.name: research_status
functions.description: Read disk state to recover progress after context truncation: shows facts collected per sub-question, gaps left, and the next recommended step.

functions.name: research_write
functions.description: Save a section or assemble the final cited Markdown report (.md) on disk, verify every [Sn] citation against saved pages, and return the report file path.

section.description: Optional 1-based section number to save before finalizing

text.description: Optional Markdown prose for that section with [Sn] citations

sections.description: Optional map of section numbers ('1', '2', ...) to Markdown prose with [Sn] citations to save multiple sections in one call

output.description: Optional .md path in the workspace for the final report

finalize.description: Set true to build the complete report.md, verify all [Sn] quotes against saved sources, and return the saved .md file path
